proves.claim: replayClaims runs the given number of pull claims on a copy of the board database, each rolled back, and returns p50, p95 and max in milliseconds while the source database file stays byte for byte unchanged.

api.io-claim-replay.replay-p95.why: Without this test the claim path's cost per claim at a real board's size is measured by nobody, and a slow addition stalls the fleet before anyone sees it.

proves.claim: replayClaims throws before writing any copy when the free space reported for the temp directory is under twice the source database size, and the temp directory is unchanged.

api.io-claim-replay.free-space-guard.why: A copy of a multi-gigabyte board once filled the volume; the guard keeps a measurement from doing it again.

proves.claim: replayClaims over a scratch board built by the test helper prints one line with p50, p95 and max for 50 claims.

api.io-claim-replay.real-path.why: The one-line figure is what a gate reads to see a claim's cost at a board's size.
